test_title: PYST 10: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must NOT be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Hockey ∶ Agha Khan Cup
solution:
The logic here is as follows:

__**GAME : Trophy Associated with GAME.**__

**In Hockey ∶ Agha Khan Cup →**

Agha Khan Cup is associated with the Hockey.

Similarly;

**In Football ∶ Subroto Cup →**

Subroto Cup is associated with the Football.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Football ∶ Subroto Cup".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] __Mistake Points__**1) **Deodhar Trophy ∶ Cricket →**

Deodhar Trophy is related to Cricket but here Trophy written at first place and Game is written at Second Place.

So, this cannot be the correct answer.

**2) Dhyan Chand Trophy ∶ Hockey →**

Dhyan Chand Trophy is related to Hockey but here Trophy written at first place and Game is written at Second Place.

So, this cannot be the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**Logic followed in the Question is;

__GAME : Trophy Associated with GAME.__

**But the logic followed in the Option (1) and Option (3) is;**

__Trophy Associated with GAME : __​__GAME.__

That's why option (1) and (3) not correct.
